text: Hello Cousin FOX! What did you get my father for his birthday? I already gave him a brand new crown.
No time to talk gifts — the MACHINE FLEET is malfunctioning. They just attacked me!
That's impossible. You are always trying to get attention, just like my brother MAX — who hasn't even gotten our Father a present yet!
MAX, I know you will help me warn the King about the MACHINE FLEET, right?

He already started the tournament, with me as the final bout as defending champion. I barely have time to get his present before I compete, and the celebration tonight. Michelle told me where some sweet relics are, if I can't find any sea pearls!
You know MAX. Always thinking with his sword, leaving things to the last minute and forgetting details. He will never make a good King... Are you going to challenge him in the Arena today?
I will, if it means I get to see the King.
I hope you crush MAX. I would compete myself, but I have something else that needs my attention.
